verdict.rationale: Segment's pricing page markets 'Build AI-powered audiences from a complete customer view' (segment-docs-37), suggesting some AI-assisted audience building exists, and Audiences are built from tracked events/traits/computed traits within the actual schema (segment-docs-9, segment-docs-38). However, there is no documentation describing a natural-language interface, an AI-generated segment definition for human review, or how schema grounding works in that flow. Missing for 10: docs/screenshots of the NL prompt-to-segment workflow, evidence of a review/edit step before activation, and confirmation the AI reads the live schema rather than generic templates.
